403:       FacetsCollector.MatchingDocs hits,
404:       Bits liveDocs)
405:       throws IOException {

414:     // It's slightly more efficient to work against SortedDocValues if the field is actually

420:     // all doc values for this segment:

422:     if (hits == null) {
423:       assert liveDocs != null;

433:     // we just want top K?  ie, this is the same algo

443:           increment(singleValues.ordValue());
444:           totalDocCount++;
445:         }
446:       } else {
